about_the_game:
Story:
You received a love letter from an anonymous admirer, and you must meet them at the top of the local mountain. However, be warned: a mysterious man is roaming the area locally dubbed the "Moaning Moron of the Mountain".

Mechanics:
Duck into the bushes to elude the Moron. Navigate the mountain as the sun sets with your flashlight. Scare off the so-called "Moron" with your college-level textbook.

Get to the top of the mountain and reach your romantic interest, but don't get caught by the "Moaning Moron of the Mountain"!

content_descriptors.notes: Mentions of sexual activities and body parts.

short_description: Moaning Moron of the Mountain is an adventure thriller that puts you in the place of a college student who got a love letter and an invitation to the local mountain peak. But be warned, there is a mysterious man on the mountain harassing hikers. Sneak past him and meet your sweetheart!
